## Statement

The first substantive paragraph of a page says what the page is about in plain terms, so a system extracting one passage has a self-contained passage to extract rather than an introduction that only makes sense after the rest.

## Rationale

A passage lifted out of context has to stand alone, and an opening built from scene-setting or a marketing preamble carries no statement of the subject for anything to extract.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "content_publication",
    "editorial_content"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Put the direct answer or definition first and the context after it, keeping the opening readable as prose rather than compressing it into a summary box aimed at machines.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Extract the first paragraph of each content route and check that it names the subject without depending on later text.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `ROUTE`, `MANUAL_ACTION`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `AI_ASSISTANT_RETRIEVAL`, `GOOGLE_SEARCH`
